name: sticky-index
title: Sticky Index
description: A sticky side index lists the page's sections and highlights the one you are reading, with a marker that slides between entries.

meta.reducedMotion: The marker jumps instead of sliding.
meta.useWhen: Long case studies, reports, documentation, annual reviews.
meta.avoidWhen: Short pages; mobile (it collapses to a top select); landing pages.
